eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Idaho; Lincoln, MT; Malheur, OR; at 9:15 PM on AUG 22, 2026 Effective until 11:15 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the amber alert system.  This is the Idaho State Communications Center. We have just received this important information regarding a child abducted in Payette County. Law Enforcement is looking for a child who was last seen at Railroad lane in Payette, Idaho at 6 p m and is believed to be in danger. The childs name is Izabella Bond. She is a 7 year old female with brown hair and was last seen wearing a blue skirt, brown boots and a t shirt. Authorities say that the child may be in the company of Amber Farson, a white female who is 5 feet 4 inches tall weighing 130 lbs. If you have any information on the where abouts of this child, please contact 9 1 1 immediately.
